name: Celentano Pizzeria
kurzbeschreibung: Celentano Pizzeria in Tirol Discover authentic Italian pizza in the heart of Tirol! At Celentano Pizzeria, we bring the flavors of Naples to Innsbruck and the surrounding region.
beschreibung: The Celentano Pizzeria in Innsbruck is a popular restaurant that delights its guests with a varied menu and authentic regional hospitality. The ambiance blends traditional Tyrolean elements with modern comfort, creating an inviting setting for every occasion. The menu features a carefully curated selection of dishes – from classic Tyrolean specialties like Tiroler Gröstl and Kaiserschmarrn to international favorites. The team places particular emphasis on using fresh, regional ingredients sourced from the surrounding area. Whether for a cozy dinner for two, a family celebration, or a business meeting – Celentano Pizzeria welcomes you warmly and ensures a thoroughly enjoyable visit with its attentive service.
